defect_title: Lateral-Torsional Buckling Governing Method & C1 Factor
audit_root_cause_finding: Audit found C1=1.75 persisted in governing capacity and load path Step 4 despite rafter experiencing parabolic UDL uplift
remediation_specification: Created LTBCalculationMethod architecture; eliminated C1=1.75 from governing capacity; established governing capacity strictly on parabolic Cb=1.2987 (Md=90.40 kNm UR=0.447); retained C1=1.75 strictly as historical comparative reference; updated load path Step 4
residual_risk_or_site_hold: Fly bracing mandatory at 4.556 m to prevent full-span LTB failure (UR=1.089 > 1.0)

defect_title: Fly-Bracing Complete Restraint System & Series Stiffness
audit_root_cause_finding: Simplified brace model assumed universal K_bolt=50 kN/mm and ignored standard clearance bolt slip and purlin roll flexibility
remediation_specification: Implemented complete series spring model (strut cleat bolt purlin web purlin roll); mandated pre-tensioned HSFG M12 Gr 8.8 bolts (IS 4000) or welded cleat (V_dsf=17.0 kN > 4.969 kN); flagged purlin web stiffener; classified restraint system as conditionally adequate pending site diaphragm verification
residual_risk_or_site_hold: HSFG bolt torque wrench audit and roof diaphragm shear stiffness verification required (HOLD-07)

audit_root_cause_finding: Checking abs(dx)<1e-6 and abs(dy)<1e-6 erroneously zeroed out local centroidal inertia I0x I0y I0xy for arbitrary inclined weld segments; lacked 6-DOF multi-axis loading check
remediation_specification: Updated WeldSegment with sin_theta cos_theta; derived transformed local inertia I0x I0y I0xy for arbitrary angles (Blodgett 1966); added product of inertia Ixy; implemented evaluate_6dof_combined_stress() with unsymmetric bending and vector shear stress summation per IS 800 Cl 10.5.10.1.1
residual_risk_or_site_hold: Weld throat thickness tt=4.20 mm (0.70*6mm) must be verified by dry film / fillet gauge inspection on-site

audit_root_cause_finding: Generic anchor checks lacked product ETA qualification Temperature Range II cracked derating (tau_Rk_cr=6.5 MPa) and concrete clearance (h_min=161mm > 150mm slab)
remediation_specification: Parameterized Hilti HIT-RE 500 V4 with HAS-U M16 Gr 8.8 under ETA-20/0541 / EN 1992-4; applied 50C/72C cracked derating (tau_Rk_cr=6.5 MPa); enforced h_min=161 mm physical blocking in 150 mm slab; classified hef=80mm alternative as conditionally feasible subject to GPR rebar scan and pull test; added rebar clash risk flag
residual_risk_or_site_hold: Physical slab core/GPR survey (HOLD-01) and 27.75 kN proof load testing (HOLD-12) mandatory before construction

defect_title: Hardened Test Isolation & File Integrity Verification
audit_root_cause_finding: ConnectionAuditor only checked sqlite3.connect via string matching allowing bypass via symlinks URIs and sqlite3.Connection direct class calls; lacked file-level hash manifests of drawings and PDFs
remediation_specification: Implemented canonicalize_path() with os.path.realpath and URI stripping; intercepted both sqlite3.connect and sqlite3.Connection via AuditedConnection subclass; implemented capture_directory_manifest() capturing file-level SHA-256 hashes across all 5 DXFs and 33 PDFs pre- and post-test
residual_risk_or_site_hold: Zero production DB access and 100% cryptographic file invariance proven across 208 unit tests

audit_root_cause_finding: Tests lacked formal categorization and independent first-principles benchmark cross-checks against authoritative structural literature
remediation_specification: Classified all 15 tests into ASME V&V 10 / IEEE 1012 Categories A through O; embedded first-principles independent solvers (SP 6(1)
residual_risk_or_site_hold: BS 8539); verified all 208 full-suite tests pass
column15: Calculation benchmarks fully reproducible with zero circular dependency
